text:
Nora: quick thread 7 ACME wants guaranteed burst for Premium pilot. do we change tier or add an addon?
Diego: addon for pilot. call it "burst_reserve". easier to sunset.
Priya: agree. must define billing (reserved vs actual), rollback window, and exposure cap.
Caleb: finance prefers reserved_tokens + overage. proration on signup/termination. recommend 12d soft-exit.
Nora: 12 days works. ops: can we carve a reserve pool or do we need routing tags?
ops-bot: current infra lacks pool isolation. opened INF-5077 to add reserve pool + fallback plan (route to best-effort).
Priya: launch checklist bullets:
- PRD: config schema + priority_tag
- Billing: reserved token accounting, proration rules, exposure cap
- Docs: pricing snippet + sales FAQ
- Ops playbook: pool exhaustion & degrade path
- Legal: contract clause for 12d soft-exit
Diego: propose pilot terms: 25% discount for first 3 months, per-customer exposure cap $40k.
Caleb: finance ok if exposure cap enforced. suggests telemetry for reserved_vs_used to evaluate econ.
Nora: decision (tentative): addon "burst_reserve", reserved+overage billing, 12d soft-exit, 25% pilot discount, $40k cap.
Priya: next steps: Nora will draft PRD + pricing snippet; Diego will prep sales SOW; Ops to estimate INF-5077.
ops-bot: INF-5077 assigned to @infra-team. ETA: estimate by EOD Thu.
Nora: thanks all. please react with :thumbsup: if ok, otherwise flag concerns.
